role: CI guard (make skip-budget; ci.yml, gates.yml) that the number of XCTSkip/XCTSkipIf/XCTSkipUnless call sites in the test directories (default EmuquTests and EmuquUITests) does not exceed .ci/test_skip_budget.txt.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; no cd (relies on cwd = repo root). TEST_DIRS = the arguments, or EmuquTests and EmuquUITests when none; a directory that does not exist -> exit 66. read_budget validates the file. Per .swift file under TEST_DIRS, grep -cE counts lines matching `(^|[^/[:alnum:]_])(try +)?(throw +)?XCTSkip(Unless|If)?\(` (lines where the call is preceded by `/` such as `// XCTSkip(` are excluded, but `/* XCTSkip(` or a call inside a string are counted; two calls on one line count once). Prints count vs budget; if count > budget prints every matching line under TEST_DIRS and exits 1. Appends a summary to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when set. Passing below budget does not report slack.

units.does: Reads the budget file path $1: exits 66 if missing, strips all whitespace, exits 65 unless the result is all digits, prints the integer without newline.
